row.evidence: Broadcom's Carbon Black Cloud guide says "You can enable SAML integration with Carbon Black Cloud and Broadcom's AuthHub" through a support ticket, and users are managed in the console or "with the User Management API"; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Carbon Black is sold through Broadcom partners and sales with no public price list. SAML federation goes through Broadcom AuthHub and must be requested by a Super Admin in a support ticket; IdP-initiated login is not supported and each email domain needs its own IdP configuration. Which products or tiers include SAML is not stated, so sso_plan is null. No SCIM; the REST User Management API (any Carbon Black Cloud product, identity managed in CBC) creates, modifies, lists and deletes users, and the Grants API assigns roles; an Audit Logs API is available on any product. Okta's catalogue app is SAML only. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.name: Carbon Black Cloud (Endpoint Standard, Enterprise EDR, XDR and other products)
plans.notes: No public price list; products are bought through Broadcom partners or sales. SAML needs a support ticket; which products include it is not stated.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint appears in the Carbon Black Cloud user guide (Managing Users, SAML federation via Broadcom AuthHub) or the developer API index; users are managed in the console or through the User Management API. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: List all users in an organization
Create (invite) a user with a role; auth_method PASSWORD or SAML
Create a grant (role assignment) for a principal
List roles the caller may assign

limitations.text: The API key can only grant roles with permissions it already holds (no privilege escalation).
Requires identity managed within Carbon Black Cloud.
Administrators cannot be deleted from the console Users page.

okta.notes: OIN 'VMware Carbon Black Cloud' app marks only SAML (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (vmware-carbon-black-cloud-tutorial and carbon-black-tutorial return 404).

fallbacks.notes: Neither the SAML page nor the user guide says whether SAML creates users on first login.
